# Microduck BallKick 4096x6000

This repository stores the Microduck right foot kick policy reproduction of the every-embodied tutorial. The training is based on `pollen-robotics/microduck_rl`, and the submission is `29e887ecfbf5d37144759e5a9f8a176dfb83d547`, with the task being `Mjlab-BallKick-Flat-MicroDuck`.

## Training Records

- Parallel environment: 4096
- PPO iterations: 6000
- Total transition count: 589,824,000
- Training time: 2 hours 6 minutes 15 seconds
- Final mean reward: 89.42
- Final mean episode length: 250.0
- Final `ball_forward_velocity` reward: 11.4758

These values only describe this run and should not be considered independent of code submission, task configuration, and random seeds as the cross-project ranking results.

## Files

- `model_5999.pt`: Final RSL-RL checkpoint.
- `ball_kick_right_6000.onnx`: The right foot policy used for Microduck’s 61-dimensional observation and 14-dimensional action operation.
- `microduck_ballkick_visual_qa.json`: Machine-readable records for training, browser closed loop, contact scanning, and demonstration videos.

## Usage Boundaries

This policy does not receive image or ball position data, and only executes one blind kick. The tutorial webpage uses a separate visual detection interface and a finite state machine to identify the ball, approach, foot placement alignment, and policy switching. It provides a first-person view from the head, a second-person view at close range, and a third-person view centered. The detection boxes in the browser demo are obtained through MuJoCo truth values projection and are used to verify the control interface; they do not represent any training or evaluation of the visual detector.

For full descriptions, commands, and videos, see [every-embodied](https://github.com/datawhalechina/every-embodied)'s Microduck reinforcement learning chapter.
